overall: The AG found the Swansea Recreation Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by listing "Swansea Rec Coordinator/ interviews" in its March 5, 2019 notice without naming the anticipated interviewees, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the March 5, 2019 meeting notice failed to list the names of candidates the Commission anticipated interviewing for a recreation coordinator post.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the notice should have included the identities of all anticipated interviewees.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Commission that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
